user.title: Connect a LeetCode profile
user.description: Enter your LeetCode username. The default API endpoint is the public alfa-leetcode-api instance; replace it with the URL of your self-hosted instance if you run one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect LeetCode profile
reauth_confirm.description: Confirm or update the LeetCode username for this profile.

reconfigure.title: Update LeetCode profile
reconfigure.description: Change the username or API base URL for this profile.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the LeetCode API. Check your network and the configured base URL.
error.rate_limited: The API rate limit (120 requests / hour for the public instance) is currently exceeded. Try again later or self-host alfa-leetcode-api.
error.unknown_user: That username could not be found on LeetCode.

abort.already_configured: This LeetCode profile is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The new profile does not match the existing entry.

init.title: LeetCode options
init.description: Adjust polling cadence and the streak-warning threshold. The minimum polling interval is 5 minutes (the upstream API caches responses for 5 min).

data_description.streak_warning_hour: Hour of the day (0-23, local time) at which the "streak at risk" binary sensor flips on if you have not yet submitted a problem today.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach the LeetCode API.

rate_limited.message: The LeetCode API rate limit is currently exceeded.

unknown_user.message: The configured LeetCode username was not found.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Refresh LeetCode data immediately, bypassing the configured polling interval.

entry_id.name: Profile
entry_id.description: The LeetCode profile to refresh. If omitted, every configured profile is refreshed.

fetch_problem.name: Fetch problem
fetch_problem.description: Fetch a single LeetCode problem's metadata by its title slug. Returns the data so it can be consumed by templates, notifications, or TTS.

title_slug.name: Title slug
title_slug.description: The URL-safe slug of the problem (the part after /problems/ in the LeetCode URL).
